script_text: Stop everything, Aries — the cosmos has something urgent for you. Mars, your fire-driven ruler in Scorpio, is locking into a square with Jupiter across your 8th House of deep transformation, forcing buried truths to surface. Your cardinal fire nature craves motion, but this 8th House pressure demands stillness before movement. In love, this Jupiter square activates your 7th House of partnerships — a confession or hidden truth from someone close reshapes a relationship today. Don't dodge it; address it head-on. Financially, your 2nd House of earned income sees Mars amplifying your spending instincts — pause before any major purchase or contract signing after 3pm. The gift here? Saturn in Aries trining your 1st House rewards the patient with unexpected clarity. Your call to action is simple: journal your fears before sunset. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
